reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Encodes:
      (1) CA Streets & Highways Code  392 (2021) (Route 92; relinquishment; signage duties)
      (2) The question's factual scenario (California, 2021, eviction-case forum question)
    And derives housing_answer(yes/no) from the encoded statutes + scenario.
*/

/* =========================
   STATUTE TRANSLATION
   ========================= */

/* CA St & Hwy Code  392(a) (2021): Route 92 is from:
   (1) Route 1 near Half Moon Bay to Route 280.
   (2) Route 280 to Route 238 in Hayward.
*/
statute_ca_shc_392_route92_segment(1, from(route_1_near_half_moon_bay), to(route_280)).
statute_ca_shc_392_route92_segment(2, from(route_280), to(route_238_in_hayward)).

/* CA St & Hwy Code  392(b) (2021):
   The relinquished former portion of Route 92 within the City of Hayward:
     - is not a state highway
     - is not eligible for adoption under Section 81
   Also: for the relinquished former portion, the City of Hayward shall maintain signs
   within its jurisdiction directing motorists to the continuation of Route 92 or to the state highway system.
*/
statute_ca_shc_392_relinquished_former_portion_in_hayward(not_state_highway).
statute_ca_shc_392_relinquished_former_portion_in_hayward(ineligible_for_adoption_under_section_81).
statute_ca_shc_392_city_of_hayward_duty(maintain_signs_directing_motorists).

/* CA St & Hwy Code  392(c)(1) (2021):
   The commission may relinquish to the City of Hayward all or any portion of Route 92
   located within the city limits, upon terms/conditions in best interests of the state,
   if the department and the city enter into an agreement providing for that relinquishment.
*/
statute_ca_shc_392_commission_may_relinquish_to_city_of_hayward(yes).
statute_ca_shc_392_relinquishment_prerequisite(agreement_between_department_and_city).

/* CA St & Hwy Code  392(c)(2) (2021):
   A relinquishment under this subdivision becomes effective immediately after the county recorder's
   recordation of the relinquishment resolution containing the commission's approval.
*/
statute_ca_shc_392_relinquishment_effective_upon(recordation_by_county_recorder).

/* CA St & Hwy Code  392(c)(3) (2021):
   On and after the effective date of relinquishment:
     (A) relinquished portion ceases to be a state highway
     (B) relinquished portion is ineligible for future adoption under Section 81
*/
statute_ca_shc_392_effect_after_relinquishment(ceases_to_be_state_highway).
statute_ca_shc_392_effect_after_relinquishment(ineligible_for_future_adoption_under_section_81).

/* CA St & Hwy Code  392(c)(4) (2021):
   For relinquished portions of Route 92, the City of Hayward shall maintain signs within its jurisdiction
   directing motorists to the continuation of Route 92 or to the state highway system, as applicable.
*/
statute_ca_shc_392_city_of_hayward_duty_for_relinquished_portions(maintain_signs_directing_motorists).

/* Helper: whether any encoded statute speaks to court forum for eviction cases.
   (Given the provided statute text, none do; this predicate deterministically fails.)
*/
legal_rule_eviction_first_heard_state_court(_State, _Year) :-
    fail.


/* =========================
   SCENARIO (QUESTION) FACTS
   ========================= */

scenario_state(california).
scenario_focus_year(2021).
scenario_case_type(eviction).
scenario_question(is_eviction_first_heard_in_state_court).

/* scenario_statement/0 succeeds when the encoded scenario facts are present */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(california),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_case_type(eviction),
    scenario_question(is_eviction_first_heard_in_state_court).

/* =========================
   REASONING
   ========================= */

/* We can answer "yes" only if, from the encoded statutes, we can derive
   that eviction cases are first heard in state court in the scenario's state/year.
*/
derived_eviction_first_heard_in_state_court :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    legal_rule_eviction_first_heard_state_court(State, Year).

/* =========================
   FINAL ANSWER
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    derived_eviction_first_heard_in_state_court,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

/* =========================
   MAIN ENTRYPOINT
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Are eviction cases first heard in state court?
